theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lp_imc_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector N n) (ξ' : MultiVector (N + 1) (n + 1)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) (n + 1)) (β : Covector (Euclid N) n), (∀ v : Fin n → Euclid N, β v = α (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ξ' α = ξ β) → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ' (Submodule.span ℝ (insert (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) ((fun v : Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (Q : Set (Euclid N)))))
